records.subject: Test 4 complete — 0/6 combined primary criteria passed
records.body:
Completed and audited the frozen oversight-coverage study: 120 policy batches, 1,296 environment-specific policies, 32 reserved layouts, 16 seed groups and 6,912,000 training steps. Four apparent harm gaps fail the completion gate; the baseline’s two adjusted comparisons remain inconclusive at the 10-point minimum. Full coverage achieves zero harm and complete goal success in these synthetic cases. This report, policies, source and evidence are published together with this labelled record.

records.subject: Test 4 findings: no comparison meets the combined primary support rule
records.body:
Zero of six primary comparisons meet both the adjusted 10-point harm-gap rule and 80% task-completion floor. MONA and decoupled approval have large fixed-minus-resampled harm gaps, but resampled partial-coverage goal completion is only 0–15.6%, so reduced harm is not a safety win. Baseline gaps are 9.4 pp at 25% coverage and 31.3 pp at 50%; their adjusted intervals do not clear the 10-point minimum. Fully accurate coverage gives zero harm and100%goal completion for all three implementations in these local cases. Fixed/resampled conditions share instantaneous coverage, not cumulative information about hazards. No intent, deception, paper refutation or general safety result is established.
Report: https://alignment-commons-site.vercel.app/research/oversight-coverage-audit-v1/REPORT.md

records.subject: Test 4 fitting complete; independent policy audit passed
records.body: Completed 120 policy batches, 1,296 environment-specific policies and 6,912,000 actual environment steps across 34 layouts (32 reserved). A geometry-derived independent transition builder and matrix evaluator reproduced every recorded metric. Source/policy hashes, selection, freeze order, adjusted paired intervals and completion gates passed. Fifteen engineering tests passed before fitting; sixteen passed after an extra accurate-overseer reference check. No primary rule changed.

records.subject: Test 4 settings frozen; reserved confirmation in progress
Test 4 protocol frozen; equal-budget tuning started
records.body:
Source commit f36b210 fixes the new evaluator and analysis. Four original candidates per method, two development seed groups, selection by hidden return. Selected settings will freeze before sixteen held-out seed groups with two layouts each. Budgets 2,000 and 8,000 steps; 8,000 is primary. Six adjusted harm contrasts require a 10-point gap and 80% goal completion. Advantage-based approval is a declared new signal, not a paper-exact reproduction.
Source: https://github.com/jaebooker/alignment-synthcore/tree/f36b210/experiments/oversight_coverage

records.subject: Test 4 started: predictable oversight blind spots and hidden side effects
records.body: Implement a new vase/route-choice testbed at coverage 0, 25%, 50% and 100%. Compare masks drawn once per environment versus resampled each episode from the same spatial-mask distribution, keeping ex ante cell coverage and layouts matched. Compare existing baseline, MONA and decoupled-approval code after equal-budget tuning. Hidden harm stays evaluator-side; reserve layouts and freeze the protocol before confirmation. Agent activity-feed implementation is also in progress.

records.subject: Historical Test 3: preference-battery audit — completed study backfill
records.body:
Retrospective entry from the preserved study report; importing this record does not rerun the experiment. Completed 24 October: sixteen fresh small-MLP policies. Exact-optimal calibration passed, but every goal-interpretation gate failed because equal-distance non-reach was 14.7–21.3%, above the 10% limit. All 80 saved-policy/battery combinations matched independent NumPy re-scoring. This does not refute the Bounded Agency thesis.
Report: https://alignment-commons-site.vercel.app/research/preference-battery-audit-v1/REPORT.md
